transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Well, Doctor, I came in because... I keep doing these odd things, mostly at church. Like, I'll be standing by the potluck table and I just hold the serving spoon up in the air. Just holding it and not moving at all. Or sometimes I'll stand there folding the exact same stack of napkins over and over again, even when folks are right there waiting on me to move. It's just... it's strange, and I wanted to know why I'm doing it.
During those moments when you freeze or repeat an action, are you fully aware of what is happening around you?

Well... I'm really not sure. I can't rightly say if I'm aware or not. I don't remember noticing what everyone else is doing right in that exact moment... I just sort of realize after the fact that they've been standing there waiting on me.
Right after one of these moments ends, do you feel confused or foggy-headed?

No, I wouldn't say I feel confused... or foggy. Once I start moving again, my mind is clear as a bell. I know I'm at the church, and I know who I'm looking at. 

I just sort of... go right back to what I was doing. I might feel a little embarrassed that I held up the line, but my head feels just fine.
About how long do these freezing spells usually last?

Well, I couldn't rightly tell you an exact time. I've never timed it... and since I don't really notice it while it's happening, it's hard to say. 

I guess it might just be a minute or two? I'm just not sure. It's just long enough for folks to get backed up in the line behind me, but I don't think it lasts a real long time.
Do you notice any warning signs or unusual sensations right before one of these moments happens?

No, I can't say that I do. I don't feel anything strange coming on or get any sort of warning. It just... happens, I suppose. One minute I'm doing what I'm supposed to be doing, and the next, well, folks are waiting on me. I don't feel any different beforehand.
Have you ever experienced sudden muscle jerks or twitches, especially in your arms or hands?
No, I haven't noticed anything like that. My arms and hands are steady enough. I don't get any jerking or twitching.
Have you ever had a seizure where your whole body stiffened and shook uncontrollably?

No, I've never had anything like that happen. I've never fallen down shaking or had a seizure. It's really just those moments where I stop what I'm doing, but my body doesn't get stiff and shake all over.
Has anyone ever mentioned that you make chewing, swallowing, or lip-smacking motions during these episodes?
No, nobody's ever said anything like that to me. I haven't heard anyone mention that I do any... well, any lip-smacking or chewing. As far as I know, my mouth just stays still and I'm just quiet.
Has anyone ever mentioned that your eyelids flutter or your eyes blink rapidly during these episodes?
No, I haven't heard that either. Nobody has said anything about my eyes blinking fast or fluttering. I think I just stare straight ahead.
